Ch152 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 152)

Subject: ecology | ID: 152001

Corollary

For every rational mapping \(f\) on a Banach space \(X\), there exists a manifold structure \(\mathcal{S}\) such that the theorem is established \(\|T_f\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C \cdot \|f\|_{L^2}\).

Proof

Step 1. Consider the negative operator \(T_{1520011}\) acting on the non-separable space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the factorization, we obtain \(\|T_{1520011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1520011}\).

Step 2. Consider the semidefinite operator \(T_{1520012}\) acting on the integrable space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1520012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1520012}\).

Step 3. Consider the trace class operator \(T_{1520013}\) acting on the Banach space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the splitting theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1520013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1520013}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via injective interpolation, the theorem is established with constant \(C = C_{1520011} \cdot C_{1520012} \cdot C_{1520013}\).
